title: Integrity Engineer
description:
Job Function:

Employment Type: Permanent

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

Sumary:

Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment.

As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records.
  • Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations.
  • Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.
  • Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modification schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements.
  • Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation.
  • Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance.
  • Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.
  • Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity.
  • Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality.
  • Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence.
  • Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Engineering degree is mandatory.
  • CREA‑RJ accreditation is required.
  • Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred.
  • Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.

A Ademicon é a maior administradora independente de consórcios do Brasil. Com mais de 30 anos de história e presença nacional e internacional, somos referência em inovação, solidez e geração de valor para pessoas e empresas que buscam construir patrimônio de forma inteligente. Oferecemos consórcios de imóveis, veículos leves, pesados e serviços, com condições flexíveis e soluções financeiras pensadas para atender diferentes projetos de vida e expansão de negócios.

Com mais de 80 bilhões em créditos ativos e milhares de clientes contemplados, entregamos uma experiência completa: desde o planejamento da compra até a realização do sonho ou investimento. Acreditamos que democratizar o acesso ao crédito e impulsionar o desenvolvimento local são pilares para transformar a vida de famílias e fortalecer empresas.

Buscamos Consultores e Gestores Comerciais com visão empreendedora e habilidade de relacionamento com clientes diversos (PF e PJ) para atuar na unidade da Ademicon Metropolitano (Shopping Metropolitano) .

O dia a dia envolve a gestão de equipes, atuação com vendas consultivas de produtos financeiros – Consórcio de Veículos, Imóveis e Serviços - com foco na construção de relacionamentos sólidos e de longo prazo, assim como a atração e capacitação de novos consultores.

Nosso propósito é trazer impacto financeiro positivo para famílias e negócios.

Regime presencial com flexibilidade.

Principais Atividades - Consultores

  • O dia a dia envolve a atuação com vendas consultivas de Consórcios de Imóveis, Veículos e Serviços;
  • Prospecção ativa de clientes potenciais (PF e PJ), gestão de carteira e pós venda;
  • Condução de reuniões com clientes potenciais englobando: identificação de necessidades, apresentação de soluções / produtos financeiros, simulação de cenários, negociação de propostas e fechamento de vendas.

Principais Atividades - Gestores

  • Gestão e treinamento constante da equipe de Vendas;
  • Acompanhamento e desenvolvimento de consultores na jornada de vendas e processos administrativos da gestão de carteira de clientes;
  • Prospecção ativa de clientes potenciais (PF e PJ), venda de produtos financeiros, gestão de carteira de clientes e pós venda;
  • Condução de reuniões com clientes potenciais englobando: identificação de necessidade, apresentação de soluções / produtos, simulação de cenários, negociação de propostas e fechamento;
  • Gestão do cliente no pós venda desde a gestão estratégica da carteira até os processos administrativos essenciais dos produtos adquiridos.

REQUISITOS DA VAGA

  • Experiência na área comercial, preferêncialmente com prospecção de clientes;
  • Experiência com vendas de produtos financeiros será um plus;
  • Alta ambição de carreira e visão empreendedora;
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Independência, autonomia com alto foco em resultados e performance;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas e prazos de entrega de resultados;

BENEFÍCIOS DA VAGA

  • Contrato PJ 100% comissionado com ganhos ilimitados;

  • Plano de carreira estruturado com perspectiva de crescimento rápido;

title: Senior Manager Human Resources Latam
description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, RJ, BR

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations.

Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high-performance, employee-centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.
    • Ensure HR strategies are effectively aligned with business priorities, fostering an adaptable and high-performing workforce.
    • Provide expert consultation to managers and senior leaders on HR-related matters.
    • Collaborate across departments to ensure a seamless employee experience and a strong people strategy.
  • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.
  • Lead efforts to enhance talent mobility and strengthen leadership capabilities within the organization.
  • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training, and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
  • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction, and long-term retention.
  • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management, and leadership development strategies.
  • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
  • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data-driven insights for business decisions.

Candidate Experience and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring strategic HR leadership at both local and regional levels, with experience in fast-paced, evolving business environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.
  • Experience in multiple locations.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English language skills, both verbal and written, Spanish is a preference.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills: ability to decompose complex problems, prioritize issues, and implement sensible solutions.
  • Track record of creating strong partnerships and influencing at all levels of the organization.
  • Superior interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to increase productivity and continuously improve methods, approaches.
  • Experience in organizational development and change management.
  • Proven ability to work in a fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality.

Dover Fueling Solutions conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other factors prohibited by law.

A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com opropósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil . Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente.

description:
Somos um grupo que tem como missão democratizar o acesso à saúde privada e ser referência em solução de saúde ambulatorial no Rio de Janeiro.

Buscamos um profissional que possa garantir assistência médica segura e eficaz por meio da execução de procedimentos clínicos e cirúrgicos, contribuindo para a recuperação e bem-estar dos pacientes.

  • Trabalho presencial: Tijuca
  • Horário: de segunda a sexta, de 9h12 às 19h.
  • Remuneração: Salário + benefícios

Atividades

SPA

  • Realizar medição de sinais vitais (pressão arterial, temperatura, frequência cardíaca, respiratória, saturação de oxigênio), conforme prescrição médica ou protocolo da instituição, para avaliar o estado de saúde do paciente e detectar alterações precoces.
  • Fazer e trocar curativos simples conforme a necessidade ou prescrição médica, para promover a cicatrização e prevenir infecções.
  • Administrar medicamentos (oral, intramuscular, intravenoso, subcutâneo), conforme prescrição médica, para tratar, controlar ou prevenir doenças e promover a recuperação do paciente.
  • Auxiliar na parte burocrática do atendimento ajudando com a documentação para agilizar o processo de atendimento.
  • Coletar sangue e urina, conforme prescrição médica, para fornecer dados laboratoriais que auxiliam no diagnóstico, monitoramento e tratamento do paciente.
  • Auxiliar médicos e enfermeiros em procedimentos (suturas, punções, intubações), conforme necessidade ou emergência, para garantir a segurança e eficiência dos procedimentos médicos.
  • Realizar eletrocardiograma (ECG), conforme prescrição médica, para detectar e monitorar condições cardíacas como arritmias e infartos.

Centro Cirúrgico

  • Exercer funções de circulante auxiliando o cirugião e equipe cirúrgica na montagem de sala e administrando os materiais da cirurgia.
  • Dar suporte ao Enfermeiro na triagem, preparando e orientando os pacientes.
  • Recepcionar o paciente, preparar e dilatar pupilas para cirurgia oftalmológica, conforme prescrição médica, utilizando colírios, para preparar o paciente para o procedimento cirúrgico.
  • Controlar e solicitar rouparia, materiais e medicamentos utilizados na área.
  • Fazer a lavagem e preparação do material de cirgurgia.

Endoscopia

  • Auxiliar a equipe médica na realização dos exames.
  • Fazer a desinfecção e controle dos aparelhos utilizados nos exames.
  • Preparar o paciente e realizar montagem da sala para os exames.

Ambulatório

  • Organizar e dar suporte para os médicos de procedimentos em consultório.
  • Organizar e repor estoque de materiais, medicamentos e aparelhos necessários para os atendimentos.
  • Organizar agendas médicas, diariamente, para garantir a organização das consultas e procedimentos médicos.

title: Sr. Director of Pre-Award
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Senior Director of Pre-Award (Outgoing Team) leads the university’s pre-award research administration function, ensuring efficient, compliant, and service-oriented proposal development and submission. The role is responsible for managing all outgoing proposals, outgoing subawards, and consultant agreements, providing direct support to faculty and research administrators while maintaining consistent quality, compliance, and operational standards across the outgoing pre-award lifecycle. As a key leader in the Sponsored Programs Office (SPO), this position provides supervisory oversight of pre-award staff, works closely with institutional leadership, and aligns pre-award services with federal, sponsor, and institutional requirements.

Supervisory Authority

  • Directly supervises Pre-Award Research Administrators and administrative support staff, including setting priorities, managing workloads, and ensuring consistent application of standards across the team.
  • Provides oversight of outgoing proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements within the Sponsored Programs Office.
  • Provides training, mentorship, and professional development to pre-award staff to ensure continuous improvement in research administration, including coaching on performance expectations and process adherence.
  • Oversees faculty engagement and training efforts, ensuring faculty and research administrators receive guidance on proposal development and compliance.
  • Collaborates with the Senior Director of Pre-Award – Incoming team to establish best practices and ensure seamless pre-award operations.

Nature And Scope

  • Reports directly to the Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Sponsored Programs and works in close collaboration with the Senior Director of Pre-Award (Incoming team) to align pre-award strategy with the university’s research mission.
  • Serves as the primary point of contact for faculty and research centers on proposal development and submission.
  • Leads the university’s outgoing proposal and outgoing subaward administration, ensuring that all submissions meet sponsor, federal, and institutional requirements.
  • Engages with Post-Award teams, Research Compliance, and Legal to support seamless research administration processes.
  • Cross-Coverage Clause: While the Senior Director of the Outgoing team primarily oversees outgoing proposals and subawards, they are expected to cross-train and collaborate with the Senior Director of the Incoming team to ensure seamless research administration operations. In the absence of the Senior Director of the Incoming team, the Senior Director of the Outgoing team may assume temporary oversight of incoming awards and agreements to maintain compliance, efficiency, and sponsor relations.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Leadership & Operations Management
    • Manages all outgoing proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements, ensuring timely and compliant submission and execution to federal, corporate, and foundation sponsors.
    • Implements workflow improvements and efficiency strategies to strengthen proposal development, intake quality, and routing discipline.
    • Establishes and enforces best practices and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for proposal development, submission, and outgoing agreement processing.
    • Monitors aging actions and escalates items at risk of deadline or compliance exposure, maintaining visibility into workload distribution and backlog status.
    • Serves as a liaison between faculty, research centers, and sponsors, ensuring successful proposal submission.
  • Proposal Development & Compliance
    • Provides technical assistance and strategic guidance for complex and high-value research proposals.
    • Reviews and ensures all outgoing proposals adhere to sponsor guidelines and university policies.
    • Oversees outgoing subaward and consultant agreements and compliance, including but not limited to pre-award subrecipient monitoring, required documentation, and risk assessments.
    • Maintains up-to-date knowledge of federal research regulations, including 2 CFR 200 and FAR/DFARS.
  • Faculty & Stakeholder Engagement
    • Develops and leads training programs for faculty, research administrators, and pre-award staff on proposal development, budgeting, and compliance.
    • Supports outreach initiatives to increase faculty participation in externally funded research.
    • Provides consultation and guidance to Principal Investigators (PIs) on proposal requirements and submission processes.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making & Performance Monitoring
    • Tracks proposal volume, success rates, sponsor trends, turnaround times, and backlog aging, using data to drive strategic and operational improvements.
    • Implements research analytics tools to measure performance and optimize pre-award workflows.
    • Provides regular reports to the AVP of Sponsored Programs on proposal activity, funding trends, operational efficiency, and documentation quality.
  • Strategic Process Leadership
    • Leads process design, policy implementation, and operational strengthening across the outgoing pre-award function.
    • Engages in strategic discussions with the AVP and Senior Director (Incoming team) on research administration improvements and institutional priorities.
    • Identifies and addresses systemic workflow gaps, documentation risks, and handoff failures to ensure audit-ready operations.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership & Team Management: Ability to supervise, train, and develop pre-award staff; set priorities; redistribute work during absences; and maintain team stability in a high-volume environment.
  • Expertise in Federal Funding & Compliance: Deep knowledge of NIH, NSF, DoD, and foundation grants, including federal compliance regulations.
  • Proposal Development & Strategy: Strong understanding of sponsor priorities, funding trends, and proposal submission requirements.
  • Operational Process Design: Ability to build, document, and enforce repeatable workflows and SOPs that support consistent, compliant operations.
  • Data Analytics & Process Improvement: Ability to track, analyze, and optimize pre-award workflows and research funding success rates.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Skilled in collaborating with faculty, administrators, legal, compliance, and external sponsors to facilitate research success.
  • Contract & Agreement Oversight: Ability to review and sign standard proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements, with the judgment to elevate complex cases appropriately.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Extensive experience in grant and contract administration is essential and will carry more weight than advanced credentials.
  • 8+ years of experience in research administration, with at least 5 years in leadership roles, preferably within a central research administration office.
  • Leadership experience is crucial, particularly in guiding and stabilizing a team dedicated to contract and agreement administration.
  • Exceptional organizational skills are a must, with the capacity to handle multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the entire lifecycle of research award administration, from the proposal phase to the award set-up.
  • Experience with outgoing subaward and consultant agreement administration, including subrecipient monitoring and risk documentation.
  • Must possess a deep understanding of federal contract requirements.
  • Comprehensive grasp of federal research compliance regulations, including 2 CFR 200 and FAR/DFARS.
  • Proficiency with enterprise research administration systems (e.g., Cayuse, Workday, or similar platforms).

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Pay Range: $145,454 - $160,000

title: Geosupport Lead
description:
Overview

Welcome to PXGEO PXGEO is an innovative marine geophysical service provider combining the strengths of ocean bottom and towed streamer seismic data acquisition techniques to deliver seamless subsurface imaging for a sustainable future.

Role Official company title is Technical Lead - Geophysics. We are seeking an experienced Geophysicist to provide technical geophysical support across the Company's Sales & Marketing, Operations, and Engineering Development teams. This role plays a critical part in ensuring exceptional data quality throughout the full project lifecycle and will be responsible for data quality assurance from the initial receipt of tenders through to the delivery of final survey products to the Client. This position requires close collaboration with internal departments to ensure surveys meet technical, commercial, and client expectations.

Key responsibilities

  • Support for Sales
    • Provide alternative and/or additional survey designs or layouts to more efficiently meet clients\' geophysical objectives
    • Review incoming data acquisition tender requests and provide technical responses, including technical exceptions, survey area maps, shooting plan scenarios and source modelling
    • Complete project time and motion estimations where required
  • Support for Marketing
    • Contribute to the technical standing of the company through publications at industry conferences and in industry journals
    • Assist in the development of the company Geophysical Initiatives
    • Attend Client Meetings as required. As an expert, participate in meetings and contribute actively to development of client relations and participate in the promotion of the company\'s image of excellence
    • Compile and present geophysical and technical slides, and present Company geophysical initiatives
  • Support for Operations
    • Prepare project start-up documentation including preplots, shooting plans, operational maps, and parameter sheets as appropriate for the seismic method
    • Attend seismic project kick-off, start-up and close-out meetings if required to represent Geophysical Services and Technology group
    • Review end of job report for accuracy and quality
    • Problem dataset analysis with appropriate reporting
    • Assist in the design, writing and implementation of procedures, methods and technical content that facilitate good survey practices and the safe and effective operations of the Geophysical Department. Contribute to continual improvement and review of working practices and standards
    • Propose and implement best practices, new technologies and methodologies in QC processing offshore and geophysical support onshore
    • Ensure the geophysical quality of projects by assisting offshore QC Geophysicists to optimize sequences and parameters, contribute to the test and QC plan adapted to the project
    • Monitor Geophysical-related downtime and inform Management of potential means to reduce downtime
    • Review detailed analysis and provide recommendations on a weekly basis for ongoing projects. Recommendations should contain the following:
      • Acquired data quality Vessel performance
      • Coverage and Infill
    • Monitor the health of the deployed receiver spread
    • Provide support for and where necessary supervision of any production processing efforts for the project whether carried out onboard or by the third party onshore
  • Support for Engineering Development
    • Provide geophysical input into the research and development portfolio
    • In cooperation with Engineering Development, conduct technical studies and tests in order to validate new technologies and methodologies
    • Assist in planning, execution and analysis of acquisition technology tests
    • Develop and design source and receiver configurations
  • General
    • Keep abreast of changes in seismic data acquisition and processing technology
    • Administration of the Company seismic project documentation sharing portal and maintain all ITT & Project location history
    • Ensure department\'s assets are tracked and maintained according to Company procedures and best practices
    • Maintain the necessary software toolbox

Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree in Geophysics, Geoscience, Physics, or a related discipline
  • At least 5+ years of extensive experience in geophysical operations including seismic acquisition and QC, within onshore and offshore environments
  • Exposure to marine seismic survey methods and technologies relating to all aspects of seismic surveys with a focus on geophysical method, and processing
  • In-depth knowledge of modern geophysical acquisition technologies and a solid understanding of emerging processing methods and their impact on acquisition design
  • Experience managing geophysical service providers and key technical suppliers
  • Solid understanding of EHSQ principles, compliance with management systems, and delivery of high-quality services
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to act as the primary technical interface for Operations

description:
Descrição da vaga

Nós somos a Fisia , a distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil.

Integramos o ecossistema do Grupo SBF e acreditamos no poder transformador que o esporte tem na vida das pessoas.

Somos guardiões de uma marca que está presente no dia a dia de milhões de pessoas no mundo todo. Nos primeiros passos no esporte, na velocidade das pistas de corrida, nas manobras de skate, na agilidade das chuteiras em campo, no lifestyle de quem se veste de esporte dos pés à cabeça.

Contamos com um time de mais de 1.000 colaboradores, que vestem a camisa com orgulho e representam não apenas uma marca, mas o compromisso de transformar a vida dos brasileiros por meio da alegria e paixão pelo esporte.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

A pessoa que ocupa a função de Consultor de Vendas é a peça chave do nosso time, pois o campo tem que estar organizado para o jogo acontecer! É a pessoa que vai encantar o nosso cliente e garantir uma experiência inesquecível em nossa loja.

  • Atendimento consultivo ao cliente
  • Excelência no atendimento
  • Fidelização dos clientes
  • Garantir uma ótima experiência de compra ao cliente.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos e tendências de moda esportiva.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Experiência anterior com vendedor em lojas de varejo
  • Habilidade com organização e reposição de produtos
  • Disponibilidade de horário (período tarde/noite)
  • Vontade de aprender e de crescer

Sobre nós

Nascemos em dezembro de 2020, somos a distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil. Integramos o ecossistema de esportes do Grupo SBF e acreditamos no poder transformador que o esporte tem na vida das pessoas. Nossa identidade foi construída nas últimas duas décadas, período em que fomos os representantes da marca no país.

Nosso dia a dia é repleto de movimento e inspiração. Somos responsáveis por trazer inovações aos consumidores brasileiros, conectá-los à marca mais admirada do mundo e manter a paixão pela prática esportiva acesa todos os dias.

Contamos com um time forte em campo, com 46 lojas, somamos mais de 1.000 colaboradores que vestem a camisa com orgulho e representam o compromisso de transformar a vida dos brasileiros por meio da alegria e do esporte.

A temporada de contratações está aberta, e o seu nome pode estar em nossa escalação. É apaixonado(a) por esporte e quer contribuir para transformar esse mercado no Brasil? Venha fazer parte do nosso ecossistema!

Realizar análise de riscos e apoio a projetos, garantindo a conformidade com políticas internas e requisitos regulatórios.
